risks: Current all-local NotesTableView may look reusable but its rows and localStorage config do not establish server ACL, all-pages totals or durable page-owned view authority.
The bounded packet has no writable authenticated server/transport registration path despite requiring two server-enforced chart operations; a renderer-only implementation cannot meet full DoD.

Only NotesViewHost is an approved shared patch path. Chart route selectors/callers, exports and ten locale files may need integration-owned scope expansion; neither note-views nor platform-contract is authorized for this worker to edit.
Published RS-BASE-01 requires RS-DRV-01 although LSX-WP-023 external_prerequisites is empty; keep the hidden gate separate from the exact two explicit dependencies.
Reference revision/digest placeholders and differing historical product baseline cannot be treated as resolved input; root must reconcile exact committed integration generation.
Old-epoch responses and focused tooltip/legend/table content can leak counts or labels even when row refs are filtered; clearing numeric and accessibility state is part of revoke acceptance.
Pagination, implicit null-to-zero, row-count/non-empty-count confusion, floating-point money and incompatible units can make chart totals disagree with Table and contributor semantics.
Ordinary source freshness changes and authorization revocation need different handling: stale policy may not display prior private totals while loading.
Surface context is a ref/revision binding mechanism, not an authenticated query authorization engine; do not upgrade browser-readable sets into proof of server permission.
Actual Electron/native restart proof and mutation sensitivity are not established by report validation, pure helper tests or screenshots of isolated fixtures.
Large sources require service-side bounded aggregation and explicit failure, not silent visible-window truncation or unbounded contributor materialization in browser.
Upstream entity kind/contentKind proposals must be reconciled by the authority owner; the chart slice must not register a second record/chart identity or store.
